_about: Design tokens for the Khatabook-core clone. No screenshots were captured in replica-recon (the user's own account was excluded per Khatabook's ToS, and public listing pages had no captioned/measurable screenshots — see recon.md). These are therefore a reasoned placeholder system for this app category, not measured from the original: a counter-use ledger app, read in bright shop light on low-end Android phones, in Hindi and English. replica-brand swaps the values; the role names and the red=outflow/green=inflow semantic should stay. Check every change with: python3 contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json

font.sans: Hind, 'Noto Sans Devanagari', system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
font._why: Hind (Indian Type Foundry, open/Google Fonts) is drawn to pair Devanagari and Latin in one family at matching weights — Inter/Geist/IBM Plex etc. have no Devanagari glyphs at all, which this app needs for its Hindi UI, not just Hindi content.

type._why: line-heights run looser than the common 12/16..40/44 scale because Devanagari matras sit above and below the baseline and clip first when a Latin-tuned line-height is reused as-is.

touch._why: the counter-speed user from fixes.md is often standing, sometimes with wet/greasy hands — tap targets default to 48px (comfortable), never below the 44px WCAG 2.5.8 minimum, even on 'sm' sized controls.
